transcript: Speaker A: Mera beta aaj hi America se lauta hai. Uski Hindi thodi kamzor hai isliye mai uuse saath le aaya. [My son has just returned from America today. His Hindi is a bit weak, so I brought him along.] Speaker B: Don't worry, I can understand English very well. Speaker A: Aapki English toh bahut achhi hai. Kya aap bhi America gyi thi? [Your English is very good. Did you also go to America?] Speaker B: Aap America jaaye bina bhi angrezi seekh sakte ho, English Seekho app se. [You can learn English even without going to America, with the English Seekho app.] Speaker A: Par aapne sirf ek app se itna kaise seekh liya? Alag se coaching bhi lagayi thhi kya? [But how did you learn so much from just one app? Did you take separate coaching too?] Speaker B: English Seekho app kisi coaching se kam nahi hai. Iske videos itne aasaan aur interesting hote hai ki mujhe kabhi laga hi nahi ki maine koi padhaai ki hai. [English Seekho app is no less than any coaching. Its videos are so easy and interesting that I never felt like I was studying.] Speaker A: Magar aap yahan market mein kiske saath practice karte ho? [But who do you practice with here in the market?] Speaker B: App mein AI hai, wo saari practice karwa deti hai. Aur galti hone par teacher ki tarah gussa nahi karti, balki ek dost ki tarah samjhati hai. [There is AI in the app, it handles all the practice. And if you make a mistake, it doesn't get angry like a teacher, but explains like a friend.] Speaker A: Toh toh yeh app mehanga hoga na? [Then this app must be expensive, right?] Speaker B: Bilkul bhi nahi. Maine khud 1 rupaye mein 3 din ka trial liya tha. [Not at all. I myself took a 3-day trial for 1 rupee.] Speaker C: Toh install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]

summary: A father and his US-returned son meet a local fruit seller who speaks fluent English. She credits her skills to the English Seekho app, highlighting its engaging videos and friendly AI coach. The ad ends with a call to action to download the app and try a 3-day trial for 1 rupee.
